name: stocksharp-desktop-driver
description: Inspect controls, capture screenshots and drive Avalonia, WPF and MAUI applications locally.
long_description: Requires the .NET 10 SDK on PATH. Applications must integrate DesktopDriver and explicitly enable automation with --ui-automation. The selected catalogue controls which applications may launch. Input into applications with real external connections requires a test profile. Local connections remain restricted to the current OS user.

catalogue.title: Application catalogue
catalogue.description: JSON file listing the instrumented applications this server may launch.

artifacts_dir.title: Screenshots folder
artifacts_dir.description: Folder for screenshots and automation artifacts.
